listen_addr.description: IP address to bind the DNS server to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

listen_port.description: Port to listen on for DNS queries.

max_udp_size.description: Maximum UDP payload size (RFC 6891 EDNS0 buffer size). Set to 512 for strict compatibility.

tcp_enabled.description: Enable TCP support (required for DNS over TCP, large responses, and DoH/DoQ).

upstream_servers.description: List of upstream DNS servers to forward queries to by default.

items.description: IP address or hostname of an upstream DNS resolver.

forward_zones.description: Domain-specific forwarding rules. Queries matching the domain suffix use the specified upstreams.

domain.description: Domain suffix (e.g., 'internal.example.com'). Must end with '.' for absolute names.

upstreams.description: Optional upstream servers for this zone only. If omitted, defaults to global upstreams.

items.description: IP address of an upstream DNS server.

local_records.description: Static DNS records served locally (bypass upstream). Useful for container hostnames or internal services.

default_ttl.description: Default TTL (seconds) for cacheable responses from local records or forwarders.

cache_size.description: Maximum number of DNS cache entries. Set to 0 to disable caching.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs emitted to stderr or log_file.

log_file.description: Path to file where access logs are written. If empty, logs go to stdout.

dnssec_enabled.description: Enable DNSSEC validation of responses. Requires upstream DNSSEC support.

trust_anchor_file.description: Path to DNSSEC trust anchor file (e.g., ICANN KSK-2017).

dns_ecs_enabled.description: Enable EDNS Client Subnet (ECS) — allows upstream resolvers to see client's subnet for geo-aware responses.

allow_from.description: List of allowed networks (CIDR) permitted to query this server.
